_comment: TIER 3 release-heavy — single universal source (like github-fast-checks for Tier 1). Deterministic prod-gate: image/SBOM/license/env-audit/zizmor + migration/schema/config/endpoint/contract/perf/build — no live URL. Triggers: push to prod-level branches (prod_branches var) OR tags v* OR workflow_dispatch (no schedule; never chained from Tier 1/2). All jobs SHA-pinned, per-stack hashFiles gates (0s skip), caches for trivy/zizmor/oasdiff/pip/npm/go. Flexible/adaptive to py/node/go/php/deno.
name: github-release-heavy
description: Universal Tier 3 deterministic release gate: Trivy image scan + size budget, CycloneDX SBOM (py/node/go/php/deno) + license denylist, env-audit (py/js/ts/go/php/deno), zizmor low, schema-drift/migration (postgres+DDL+round-trip), config-validation, endpoint-smoke (adaptive health_path/ready_path), graceful-shutdown, oasdiff contract diff, perf-benchmark (py/node/go/php/deno), build + static-asset integrity, tests-detected (all stacks), rollback-readiness. Flexible/adaptive to any stack, impactful, efficient.

variables.name: job_timeout_minutes
variables.description: Per-job timeout budget — hung jobs never burn runner minutes

variables.name: license_denylist
variables.description: Comma-separated license IDs that block deployment

variables.name: image_size_budget_mb
variables.description: Docker image size budget (MB) — fails if exceeded

variables.name: sbom_fail_on_empty
variables.description: true = fail release if SBOM has 0 components

variables.name: env_audit_strict
variables.description: true = fail on undocumented env vars, false = warn only

variables.name: prod_branches
variables.description: Comma-separated production-level branch names that trigger Tier 3 on push alongside tags v* (branch-level map: T1=dev/feature, T2=staging push, T3=prod)

notes: Tier 3 single universal file (no 3 copies) — add a stack = one hashFiles branch. Triggers: push to prod-level branches (prod_branches) OR tags v*, docs-ignored, cancel:false deterministic — no schedule (nightly removed per dev-control request; never chained from Tier 1/2). Caches: trivy/zizmor/oasdiff tarballs + pip/npm/go. Stack-aware SBOM (py/node/go/php/deno real parsers, merged polyglot) / env-audit (py/js/ts/go/php/deno, health_path aware) / endpoint-smoke (adaptive, golden 200/404/503 ready semantics) / perf (py/node/go/php/deno) / tests-detected (all stacks). release-summary also prints the PUBLIC-LAUNCH CHECKLIST (pipeline rows from job results + human sign-off rows: capacity, pentest, release watch, privacy/ToS, status page/on-call, flags, a11y) and emits launch_checklist_human in gate-summary.json. POST-RELEASE (outside the deterministic graph): release-watch is opt-in via vars RELEASE_WATCH_ENABLED/DEPLOY_PROVIDER/WATCH_URL/AUTO_ROLLBACK; it polls live health/ready for WATCH_MINUTES after a green release-summary and rolls back (vercel/wrangler; render is manual by platform design). Promotion: PR→Tier1 fast →merge→staging push Tier2 →prod push or tag v*→Tier3 release-heavy (this file). No nightly.
